pulse: A broad risk-off session: the S&P 500 fell 1.92%, the Nasdaq 100 dropped 2.67%, the Dow slid 1.41%, and the Russell 2000 lost 1.70%, with breadth decisively negative at 145 advancers versus 355 decliners out of 502 names. Producer Manufacturing (-3.78%) and Electronic Technology (-3.31%) led sector losses as chip and industrial names were hit hardest, while Technology Services (-2.70%) also lagged; Health Services (+1.81%), Consumer Non-Durables (+0.39%), and Transportation (+0.26%) were the only sectors in the green. The VIX ticked up 0.22% to 22.96, the 10Y yield rose 0.23% to 5.14%, the dollar (DXY) gained 0.17% to 103.77, WTI crude climbed 1.34% to 86.87, and gold slipped 0.50% to 3837.28. Among the most-active names, Sandisk (SNDK) tumbled 8.58%, Micron (MU) fell 7.62%, AMD dropped 5.58%, and NVDA led volume at 333.8M shares while falling 4.12%, with Apple (AAPL) the relative outperformer among mega-caps at -0.98%.
